semantics.causality: observations do not establish training causes or retraining gains
semantics.fixed_pairs: image-local query/GT assignment union; never-assigned queries use fixed D1 best-IoU GT
semantics.gt_trajectories: per-layer GT responsibility; query changes are explicit
semantics.matching: Hungarian: iou_weight*(1-IoU)+score_weight*(1-pGT); no confidence or IoU gate
semantics.official_evaluation: not performed by trajectory analysis; use CocoEvaluator separately
semantics.size_groups: diagnostic half-open intervals in original-image pixel area; not COCO AP area strata
